page.overview:
Who is Bruno Franke?

Bruno Franke is the judicial champion of Maria-Ulrike von Liebwitz. He is a tower of muscle topped with a smiling face that hints at mischief.

His Altdorf accent is deep as he was born in the Imperial capital to parents of Southlander extraction almost forty years ago. He has a distinctive, infectious laugh, and he loves a good challenge.
